Color palette: ivory base, charcoal-sage sole and footprints, dusty blue-gray stones, warm ochre metal charm, muted sage leaves, coral dots. Avoid pure #00ff00 in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
